description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galigamuwa, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610027 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Galigamuwa area. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property titles, and land settlement matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
